metadata.exportTool: WayFinder Figma Plugin Native Variables Exporter + DTCG Bridge v1.2
metadata.provenanceNote: Raw token and variable definition mapped directly from Figma file UVhhlZnqdpV0JDcAHwJczo (Collection: WayFinder Tokens). Note: Figma REST API /v1/files/:file_key/variables/local is restricted to Enterprise plans (returns HTTP 403 Forbidden on personal tokens) and subject to rate limits. Canvas variables are instantiated natively via design/figma-plugin/code.js and mirrored in this contract.
